/de'i rjes su rgya gar ba'i bsu ba rnams la/ phyag rten gyi dngos po mang po rngan par byin nas phar shad kyis brdzangs/ rjes la wā ra na si'i rgyal po zla ba la springs pa'i/ sa gsum dbang phyug lha dang mi yi rje/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i phrin yig de bskur ba yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis de tsam du nga spyan 'dren pa la nan tan che ba la/ de dgos ched ci'i phyir yin drang por smos shig rnyed grags la sogs pa'i don du yin nam/ sems can la phan 'dod pa'i don du yin gsungs/ drang por lan zhus pas bha la bha la siddhi siddhi gsungs/ dus de'i tshe phyin chad gtso bo 'gro don la phal ba rang don zhar byung tsam ma gtogs par rang 'dod lhur ma byas pa yin no/ /de nas zhe la dga' zhing 'phral du 'tsher bar byung yang / rje btsun gyi man ngag snang ba lam khyer gyi khrid dran par byas so/ /rang yul du 'di ltar byon par yod do'i 'phrin btang ste/ phal cher na re/ a tsa ra brdzun ma gcig gis mgo bskor ba yin/ mai tra yo gi dpal gyi ri la song nas lo mang ches lon no zer/ de yin na thugs rje chen po dngos yin par 'dug ste mi srid/ brdzun gyi kham che/ spyir legs nyes kyi kham ches pas gros 'di la 'phung 'tshengs kyi rngams ches thal ba gcig 'ong zer nas yid ches pa mang po ma byung ngo / /bod du dge bshes drang po lung pa bya ba/ chu mig ring mo'i gnas brtan jo bo dkar mo'i mchod gnas skyes bu dam pa gcig bzhugs te/ don zhags kyi sgrub pa mang du mdzad pa'i dpon g.yog kha cig na re/ na ning wa bo zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi smyung gnas kyi nub mo/ thugs rje chen po ras ser pos dril ba gcig sang phod khro phur byon pa yin no zer ba'i sgra gsal po gcig nged cag sgom chen pa lnga la mthun par byung zer skad/ la stod gtsang so'i srin po gdong bya ba na/ dge bshes dad pa bya ba gcig bzhugs ba na re/

nga'i rmi lam du nub sum brgyud du khyed kyi khang pa byi dor gyis/ rje mai tra yo gi brang khang g.yar du 'ong ngo zer ba byung / bden brdzun blta'o zer skad/ de nas zab chos rnams la bka' dog kyang thun mong gi gdams pa la bka' yangs par byung nas dbang bskur byin rlabs dang gdams ngag byin pa shin tu mang / lo tstsha bas sbyin bdag dang chos bsgyur ba po stabs gcig tu byas te/ de'i dus na bka'i zhal chab bag re tsam phog pas kyang don grub pa shin tu mang ngo / /rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ kha ning khyod kyis chos kyi don du srog gtong nus par byung ba des sdig sgrib dpag tu med pa phyags te/ da rung sdig sgrig bag tsam yod pas rkyen ngan pa 'ga' zhig byung na sdug bsngal myong bas 'dzad pa yin te gsungs/ de nas sngar dbyar gyi dus su g.yog po ston pa chos 'phel bya ba de tshad nad kyi thebs pa la/ bla ma paṇa chen dang / rje grub thob gnyis ka la gtor ma la sogs pa zhus pa'i tshe/ nad pa 'di yis phan mi thogs pa 'dug de bas da rung khyed rang la ngan sdig che bar yod/ rang gang mos pa'i yi dam lha la gsol ba 'debs dgos zhes zhal mthun par gsungs pas/ rje btsun byams pa'i sku khru tshad cig dbon a mo gha shrī bya ba mkhas pa gcig la bzhengs te/ de'i zhal bskos rje paṇa chen la zhus/ rab gnas rje grub thob la zhus pa dang / 'di lta bu ha cang chung bas khyed la sdar bla ma paṇa chen des ming btags pa ltar/ rje btsun byams mgon dang las 'brel nan ltar che bar yod pas khru brgyad cu pa'i sku tshad gcig bzhengs dgos gsungs/ de tsam bdag gis 'grub pa'i nus pa ma mchis/ mi'i tshad tsam bzhengs par zhu smras pas/ nus pa 'ong bas ma 'ongs pa'i tshe rje btsun byams mgon 'tshang rgya ba'i dus su/ yon bdag 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung zhes bya ba gling bzhi la dbang byed pa 'byung ba'i lo rgyus yod/

khyed sems ma zhum par byed dgos/ ngas kyang gsol ba gdab tshar nas rab gnas byed pa'i dus su nga yang 'od kyi phung po'i gzugs kyis 'ong gis gsungs/ 'o na de'i tshe dngos su byon nas mnga' gsol bar zhu byas pas/ dngos su 'ong ba'i rten 'brel ma 'dzoms/ 'od kyi gzugs su skal ba yod pa mang pos mthong bar 'ongs/ mchod pa bzang du shoms gsungs so/ /phyis de kho na ltar byung ngo / /'od kyi phung po spyil bu tsam du byung nas thugs kar yang thim/ byang shar du song ba lha rje ra phyar la sogs pas kyang mthong ba mang po byung / der 'o na nus pa 'ong srid pas smon lam zhu dgos snyam nas/ rje paṇa chen la de'i gros zhus pas khyed skal pa re che/ rje btsun 'dis lung stsal ba la ma grub pa med/ da sngon la lha chen bzhengs pa'i sems bskyed gyis gsungs/ de'i tshe rang lo nyi shu rtsa drug lon pas lo grangs dang mnyam pa'i mar me dang lha bshos dang gtor ma la sogs pa bshams nas rje paṇa chen la sems bskyed kyi cho ga zhus pa dang / sngon la rje btsun la mdo tsam zhig zhus la shog dang / de nas sangs rgyas par bya'o gsungs/ de nas me tog dang / tam po la sogs pa mang du khyer nas/ rje btsun la zhus pas nan ltar mnyes nas/ da bzod rje btsun byams pa dang mjal ba'i las 'phro bzang po la zhugs pa yin no/ /phyin chad dge sbyor gyi rnam pa gang byed pa la sngon 'gro gsol 'debs gyis brgyan pa'i sems bskyed gyis/ dngos gzhi rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis brgyan pa gyis/ rjes la smon lam thun mong dang khyad par la rgyas 'debs kyis brgyan pa gyis shig sbyor dngos rjes gsum 'di chos kyi khog chen po seng ge'i 'khrul 'khor lta bu yin no gsungs so/ /de'i tshe mdo tsam zhig phyag bzhes mdzad/ rgyas par dus bzang gcig la mchod pa ci 'byor khyer la shog 'phags pa rang byung ngam bhu kaṃ gang rung gcig tu 'deng gsungs/

de nas rje paṇa chen la de ltar bsnyad pas/ de gcig pu la rje btsun dang mjal rin chog khyed kyis nor bu rin po che am phrag tu chud pa yin gyis phyis dus bzang po zhig la ci 'grub gyis shig gsungs/ zla ba de nyid kyi tshes brgyad la/ bla ma paṇa chen gyis kyang cha rkyen gyi 'thus che bar mdzad cing sems bskyed rgyas par mdzad/ nya la cho ga dang bcas pa'i sems bskyed man ngag gsum ka dang bcas pa 'phags pa rang byung du zhus/ zhag bzhi der bzhugs nas shin tu yid ches par thugs la btags so/ /de nas ring po ma lon par tshad nad kyi thebs te/ bod du 'gro ba'i grabs kas thug bzhin du/ ta pa si'i ston mo zhig gi nyin par/ lus sems dub pa gcig byung ba la brten nas/ gnas po me lha bha ro'i khang par nub mo bar zhag byas pa'i nang par tho rangs lha khang gi mchod pa rnams kyis rnga brdungs pa dang / phyag dar byed pa thos pa la sngar dang mi 'dra bar lus nyag nyog tu song 'dug sems kyang lhag par bya rgyu med pa la bya rgyu mang po'i sems khral che bas bya yis mi lang bar bya dgos pa'i zang zing mang pos shin du brel ba gcig byung / g.yog gal che ba yang / la la der shi/ la la rgya gar du song / la la yul du song bas/ gnas pos 'phral du btang ba'i bran khol lta bu las med/ cha rkyen yang zad nas rim gro'i tshan pa nam yang med de/ cha bzhi nas nyam thag par byung / nad kyi bye brag kyang zug rngu che ba'i rigs gcig byung bas zla ba gsum du kha che bar byung / nam nyi ma langs dus nub dus med/ ston tshad smig rgyu'i khrem bu dkrigs/ tsha sbrang gi sgra skad gzir gzir 'don/ /ce spyang gi cho nge sgo drung 'bod/ /grogs bod mi shi ba'i ngu 'bod ldir/ /lus rus krang lta bur bskams na yang / /nga'i khar 'ong ba chu las med/ /chu yang dron mo 'jam 'jam po/ /de yang bal ngan sman pas bkag /glang chen 'dam du bying ba bzhin/

/rang ljid rang la non bar gyur/ /rtag tu mal du thibs por bying / /ldang bar 'dod de 'gyel zhing bub/ /nyams chung khur tshas non ba 'dra/ /gting nas thad chad yi re mug /dbang po bzhi dang mig 'bras kyang / /skya shel rig rig khung bur nub/ /kha sna ba mo khang khang song / /rkang lag ju thur yog pa bzhin/ /rlan med mgrin pa 'gags pa dang / /shed chung lus la stobs med pas/ /kha chems bzhag par 'dod na yang / /skad khar ni mi thon yid la 'gyu/ /gson du re ba nam yang med/ /rgya la gcig gcig ma shi na/ /gdams pa'i bdud rtsis phan gdags phyir/ /rje mi tra bod du byon no snyam/ de gcig pu brod pa yod pa las/ /shi yang 'phring ba mi snang mod/ /cung zad yod tshad spong dag byas/ /lus sems gnyis kyi 'brel so bcad/ /dus de tshe yi snang ba mthong nas ni/ /dgra mi sha bo yang snying rje skye/ /'on kyang zla gsum 'das pa dang / /rje bla ma rnam gnyis bka' drin gyis/ /byin rlabs kyi khrus chus lus bkrus pas/ 'phral nas 'phral du sil li li/ /rang gi nyams la dpags nas kyang / /khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /gting nas ma bcos snying rje skye/ /du kha bde chen chos su shar/ /'gro ba kun gyi du kha rnams/ /bdag la smin par gyur cig snyam/ /bdag gi nad dang du kha 'dis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par/ /ma yengs snying dkyil smon lam btab/ /smon pa'ang rgya legs 'bur bzhin byung / /ji ltar bkod ma'i chu rgyun bzhin/ /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa 'am/ /brje ba'am rang bas gzhan gces kyi/ /'du shes bar chad med pa skyes/ /de rjes ma bcos ngang la bzhag /ma bcos rkyen gyis bsgyur ba na/ /dag snang lha yi rgyas 'debs bsgoms/ /skyid sdug gzhan la gang 'byung rnams/ /thug phrad lam khyer 'dzad med bsgoms/ /skye med 'bral med 'dzad med gsum/ /nges par chos rdzogs sprul ba'i sku/

/gdams pa'i mthar thug ngo mtshar rmad/ /skam thag chu yi nang du chod/ /de ltar rje yi bka' drin gyis/ /ring por mi thogs 'phral thabs su/ /'jim snod chu yis bkrus pa bzhin/ /nad sdig dang bcas dag ste thal/ /rje bum pa bzang po sman pa'i mchog /gong ma'i sku drin rin po che/ /dus da thengs rang la btang bas chog /thabs ji ltar byas pas lan lon 'gyur/ /de nas dgun gyi zla ba rgyal du song ba na gza' las thar pa'i zla ba skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ltar gzi mdangs dang ldan zhing 'khor dang bcas pa gangs ri'i khrod du bskyod de/ de yang rgyu mtshan bzhi tshan bzhi'i sgo nas rje btsun de bod du gdan 'drongs pa la brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ snyigs ma lnga yi yang snyigs gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po thugs rjes skyes/ /rje mai tra pho nya'i byin rlabs 'bar/ /bdag gnubs ston lo chung skal bar ldan/ /rgyu 'di bzhi 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rje mai tra chen po bod du byon/ /rgya yul rdzu 'phrul bkod pas btul/ /bod yul byin rlabs gdul byar gzigs/ /gdul bya'ang ma sngas ma mchis shing / /dus 'di lo skabs la bab bo gsungs/ /rgyu 'di bzhi 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug bod du byon/ /sdar byung gi gdams pas snang ba 'gribs/ /phyis 'byung gi sgron me 'degs mkhan med/ /dus de tshe spobs na nus pa yod/ /nus mthu rje btsun nyid la rag /rgyu 'di bzhi 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rje brgya bcu lnga pa bod du byon/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /de yang rje btsun 'di lta bu sngar byon pa med pa la byon pa ya mtshan che ba'i cha lag tu mtshon pa'i rgyan dang / skye bo tha mal shas che ba rnams ltad mo phra mos bsdus nas chos la 'god pa dang / las 'brel yod pa'i sems can kha cig gi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas myur du thar ba la 'god pa'i phyir/ rgyu de gsum gyi sgo nas rma bya dang /

ne tso dang / gser gdugs la sogs pa rol mo sna tshogs kyang bshams te/ de dag gi rgyu rkyen rnams skyid grong du gnyis 'gyur dang gsum 'gyur 'jal ba'i snga dam blangs so/ /bal bod rgya gar gyi tshogs pa chen po 'dus te bal yul rang nas mi stong gi cha rkyen sbyar/ de dag ma lus pa la sku gsum zhal bsgyur gyi gdams pa btab nas ci nus kyi bsgrubs pas skyid grong du sleb pa'i bar du lam sna zin pa nyis brgya tsam byung skad/ skyid grong du sngar bas kyang 'ur chen po langs te/ pu hrangs dang / glo bo dol po la sogs pa'i ltad mo ba mang po 'dus/ phyag rten blangs pa dang gnas mal gyi tig tig la sogs pa bya bas mi lang bar gyur te/ gnyer du bskos pa'i brgya brgya tsam gyi phyag rten bsdus pa rnams/ rje btsun gyi spyan gyis lan de gzigs su bcug nas de ma thag jo bo wa ti thugs rje chen po la phul lo/ /der nam bzhugs kyi bar du 'du long gis g.yengs nas bal yul du blangs pa'i bu lon nyis 'gyur dang sum 'gyur btsal dgos rnams gzhal ba ma byung / 'gro khar bu lon len pas thug pa la zhag gsum nur nas/ slob dpon nyi ma bya ba de/ skyid grong gi 'os phug bya ba gcig tu yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma sgrub tu btang bas zhag gsum lon pa dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan dkon mchog skyabs bya bas gser srang brgyad kyi zhing phul/ kan 'jim go bzhi'i yul pas bsdus nas srang sum cu rtsa bzhi phul bas bu lon thams cad dag par byas/ rje btsun la 'bul ba thug med 'ong yang zhar la phyogs med du ster bas zhu ma nus/ tshogs pa chen po'i gnyer thams cad lo tsā bas byas pas dgos cha mang bar song nas skyid grong nas 'gur mor 'jal ba'i bu lon yang srang nyi shu tsam blangs te/ yang zhal bu'i thugs rje chen po'i pho brang du slob dpon nyi ma yid 'phrog zhag gsum sgrub tu bcug pas khyer bar byas so/

/gung thang du glang ri bas gtso byas pa dang / khab kyi rgyal pos mgo bsdus te phyag rten kyi dngos po thams cad gnyer du bskos pas bsdus nas gser zangs gzhong dang rkyal ba bkang ba dang / dar zab kyi sgro brtsig par brtsigs pa dang / rta dang mdzo g.yag ba glang ra lug la sogs pa khyu ded du byas te phul/ thams cad rang sar rang rang gi dge ba'i las ka byed pa dang / gnas dgon dang ri khrod pa'i chos pa rnams la byin/ mgron khang dang / zam mkhrang dang / yul khrims bcos pa la sogs pa la gtad/ sdug phongs la sogs pa ma lus pa ci dgar bskyangs so// //longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med pa las/ /dam pa gsum ldan snying po blangs nas ni/ /rgyags dregs drags pas gyi nar ma byed par/ /sku gsum 'bras bu'i man ngag goms par gyis/ zhes nan tan dang bcas pa'i chos yang yang gsungs so/ /de nas phyi rol gyi la rgal nas gshegs pa'i lam du/ kha la/ bya la/ gseb la/ gsum po gang nas bzhud pa'i kha zin la yul pa rnams so so nas ma mthun par 'thab mo chen po 'ong bar song / bsod nams kyi me 'bar na du kha'i mtsho rdol bya ba 'di ka 'dra yin snyam pa dang / lo tsā bas la rgyab kyi gnas sa gang legs pa gcig gong du grabs su chug cig gsungs nas rta pa 'ga' zhig springs te/ dpal thang yag dmig na dge bshes chen po mong po ba bya ba'i rten dge bsnyen khyad par can gcig bzhugs/ der khang pa g.yar bas/ la mo gsum gang nas byon yang sleb par mi gsha' ba'i dus snga mor rje btsun rang rta la chibs nas rta khrid med par byung / lam la ma mthun par thams cad mig lce re lus pa yin skad/ der 'brog pa dang / yul pa lho byang dpag tu med pa'i skye bo tshogs nas chos zhus/ rmi lam grong khyer yangs pa na/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu longs spyod pa/ /longs spyod dus na longs spyod med/ /snang sems de ltar shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs/

chos rgyus can mang po'i gegs bsal zhing yon tan mang po skyes pa byung ngo / /dge bshes mong po bya ba de la sangs rgyas brgyud phab bya ba'i gdams pa/ zur tsho bstod pa'i mdzod gcig pu bya ba zhig yod pa la/ des rje btsun la chos zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ thabs snying rje chen po'i lag len gcig bsnan dgos par gda' gsungs nas/ snying rje chen po sgom pa dang / gnas lugs kyi sgom don sbyor ba gcig gnang / zla ba gcig bsgoms pas nad gzhi thu mo sngar ye ma thon pa gcig lhur thon nas song / khyi mi khyur bcug gsung lo/ /bshes gnyen de nyid kyis bal ma mtsho 'khor gyi mi chos sgor zhugs ma zhugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig chos de ka gcig pu bstan nas kun la phan thogs pa yin skad/ de nas gdul bya'i dbang gis lam ni la stod byad la byon/ gtsang so thang chung nas bzung ste/ las kyis srin po gdong gi bar du zhal lta ba dang / chos zhu ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa'i mis gang bas lung pa che chung med par khrig rdzongs su song / gang byon sar ltad mo dang / zang zing dang / chos kyi longs spyod la thug pa med/ skye bo 'dus sa ches pas khyim thams cad zhig sgo thams cad thal byung du shor/ bza' btung 'dod pa med/ rgan gzhon med par chos kyi snang bar gyur te/ su yang 'thab rtsod dang / tshig brdeg pa dang ches chung brtsi ba ye med par snying po zlos pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la sogs par dar dir du song ngo / /las kyi srin po gdong du sleb pa na dge bshes mang po tshogs pas khyim dkon par gyur te/ dge bshes kha cig phyir rol du lus pas/ rje btsun gyi bzhugs sa bshams pa dge 'dun la btang nas/ rje btsun nyid chibs la babs te/ dge bshes dad pa bya ba'i sgo phye nas nang du gshegs skad/ dge bshes la a tsa ra la khang pa byin gsungs pas shin tu dga' ches te/ nga la na ning rmi lam du khyim g.yar du byon pa yin zer te zhing khang la sogs pa yod dgu thams cad spong dag tu phul/

dge 'dun dang skye bo tshogs tshad la ston mo chen po byas/ /dus gcig la gser g.yu mkhar sder gang phul/ snying po gsum pa'i man ngag de gnang ba yin no/ /de nas rim gyis gcung pa'i yul du 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ rme theng gi 'phrang la chibs pa bzhol bar zhus pas rta'i sgrib pa sbyang dgos gsungs te/ rta khrid pa sgom pa grwa chung pa la rta lhung na khyed shes mi lhung na nga shes gsungs/ rta 'grengs nas lhung la khad pa la grwa chung pas ma thub pa grogs po mang pos bzung / rje btsun gyis 'phrang mi bde ba kun bsgral nas mgul pa chad chad bzhad cing 'dug go /rgyang don mo rir zhag mang po'i gong nas khrom tshogs pas de nas bzung ste khad kyis tshong 'dus chags/ phyis de ka'i rjes la rim gyis zong nyo tshong gi srol de chags pa yin skad/ de'i tshe mkhan po zhang zhi mdzes bya ba bzhugs pa la/ grwa pa mi chen mang pos snyan du bcug ste/ rnal 'byor pa'i khro phu ba'i jo sras kyis spyan drangs par gda' bas/ 'o skol dang 'brel ba che bas bsnyen bkur zhabs tog ni bgyi 'tshal/ bka' gdams pas rnal 'byor pa la chos zhus pas srol la gnod pas mi mdzad pa zhu byas pas gros bya yis gsungs skad/ da ni gnang dgongs lta bur don mo rir byon pa'i grabs kha la khro phu ba'i nye gnas pa kha cig gis sleb nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / zhwa'i bar nas phyag rten gyi dar bton pa'i zhor la yi ge gcig byung / mkhan po'i zhal nas/ yi ge de ci 'dra ba gcig gda' gsungs pas/ khro phu bas/ da res byon pa'i bla ma de'i chos du ma gcig bsgyur bar gda' byas pas/ tshur ston mdzod dang gsungs te/ gzigs pas spyan chab byung / sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa la mi mnyes pa'i las de ru bsags gsungs nas/ chos de 'dir byon tsam na zhu dgos par 'dug gis/ dpe de nga la longs shig gsungs nas bsnams/ bsu ba dang zhabs tog sngar ma byung ba mdzad nas/

dge 'dun bdun brgyas phyag bskor mdzad/ lo paṇa dpon g.yog bzhi bcu tsam gzims khang du spyan drangs nas ka ra'i ting khrol mi 'tsham pa mdzad/ rje btsun la gser srang bdun maṇḍal du bkod/ lo tsā ba la srang gnyis maṇḍal du bkod/ dbu zhwa'i bar nas khar sang gis chos de phyung nas chos 'di gsung bar zhu gsungs/ chos de'i rtsa tshig ni/ cir snang rang sor bzhag na bya bral lhun gyis grub/ /gang shar ngo yis bzung na rig pa rang sar grol/ /'gyu ba'i brtsad rjes bcad na dran rtog dbyings su yal/ /rgyun chags snying rje bsgoms na gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub/ /zhes bya ba blo rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi ngo sprod thabs dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas stag tsho'i dpon mkhar re bya bas zhu ba phul nas rgyang lha ri bas gdan drangs/ char dbab par zhus pa'i nub mo char chen po byung / ra za rgyas pa'i yon mchod rnams kyis gdan drangs/ rgyang nas don mo ri'i bar la mthur mda' mthud pas sleb zer ba'i rta 'bul ba byung / rgyang gi lung par sha mar mang bas khom 'gyed byas bsnyen gnas zhu ba mang po la long skabs med pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ de ring khyod kyis go ma chod/ bsnyen gnas pa de rnams phal cher sangs rgya ba yin pa la gsung / sangs rgyas 'ong ba nyung ba ma lags sam/ lha mi mang po'i stabs bcag par thal zhus pas/ 'o skol gyi lugs kyis bsam pa gsum ldan gyis bsnyen gnas len pa la slob dgos pa yin/ spyir sems can mgon med skyabs med 'di rnams snying rje bas 'khor ba las/ thar ba'i blo bskyed/ 'ga' re thar yang ma rgan thug pa med pa 'o brgyal bas de rnams kyi don byed pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i blo bskyed dgos/ nam phugs sangs rgyas yang 'khor ba sdug thag ring bas shi ma thag dga' ldan gnas su chos la spyod pa'i thabs su blo bskyed dgos/ 'di gsum skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /

sgom pa thams cad la sbyar dgos pa yin gsungs/ lag len ma byas na shes pa tsam gyis mi phan te bu ram mngar bar shes kyang ro ma myong na don mi 'dug gsung ngo / /chos de ka gcig pu'i bka' drin la tshad mi 'dug snyam nas chibs pa gsum phul/ chos gsum la yon re re phul ba de legs so gsungs/ de phyin chad dbang med brjed pa ma gtogs pa bsam pa gsum po de rgyun du byas so/ /de nas ra za dang rgyangs nas mdzal dang khro phu'i bar du mi rta'i khrom ches pas bshag pa'i thabs ma byung / lam 'byed pa'i ring la 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa byung ba la/ nye gnas pa slob dpon nyi ma bya ba na re/ rje btsun la thabs gcig zhus pas chog zer/ zhus pas nang du rtog pa'i 'du 'dzi la ma shogs pa'i rtags yin pas rtog pa thams cad rang ngo shes na ngo bo med pa la bshag dgos pa mi 'ong / bshag rgyu nang du grol na phyi rol gyi khrom dar gcig dar gnyis na phyal gyis 'gro yis gsungs/ 'o na phyi rol de bzhin nang / bgyi ba de med par gda' a zhus pas/ mang ba mang de de skad kha nas 'don mkhan tsho lce re long du 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ de ltar dran pas rgyun du gzung zhing rje de'i gsungs la brtag na rje dam pa rgya gar ba'i gsung ji bzhin du byung bas/ zhi byed pa rnams na re/ dam pa'i sprul bar 'dug ces kyang zer ro/ /mdzal gyi zam pa ring mo la mi rta 'byed pas ma thar ba la/ rma bya dang ne tso'i rdzi mo bgres mo gcig yod pa na re/ nam lam dog tsa na/ bla ma la 'jug bzhud cha med par bzhud pa gcig 'ong gis 'dug gis ltos shig zer te ston pa phag mo dang / gnas brtan shud dge dang / jo gshen bya ba dang gsum/ kho bo dang bzhis yid gtad pas bzhi kha mthun par zam pa la gshegs pa ma mthong bar pha gir rta khrid pa med par byon 'dug der sgom pa 'bri khung pa bya bas chibs khrid nas bzhud do/ /mdzal du ltad mo la zhag gsum thob par byung nas/

kho phur bsu ba dang sna len gyi grabs la gtso che ba rnams song ba'i shul du pha jo la rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom don btab/ shi ba'i rus pa la rdo rje sems dpa' byon 'ong gsung skad/ de kho na bzhin byung nas pha jo'i gdung la gyon pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' la dpe blangs te/ byams chen gyi zhal ras tsam gcig ras la bzhengs/ phyis ras kyis mi tshad lder sku dang / des kyang mi tshad zangs sku dang / des kyang mi tshad gser sku bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad pa yin skad khro phu'i gnas gsar rnying gi bar lam yar dgon par 'gro sa'i sgang gcig la bla ma mnga' ris kyi ston gyi chos khri gcig yod pa'i sar chibs pa las babs nas nub phyogs kyi zhing gtan chung gi steng du gshegs te 'dir gtor ma thongs gsungs/ gtor ma btang bas maṇḍal shoms gsungs/ maṇḍal bshams pas me tog thor gsung skad/ de rnams ni phyis lha khang bzhengs pa dang / lha bzhengs pa dang / rab gnas mdzad pa'i brdar byung ngo / /de nas yang rtser gshegs te gcig pu thugs dam mdzad/ thag ring po nas chos dang byin rlabs zhu ba grangs med pa rnams la yi ge bskur zhing gdams ngag zab mo mang du gnang / dbang skur thengs gnyis dang byin rlabs zab mo thengs gcig mdzad/ rin chen 'bru dgu dang mthar thug dgu gsungs so/ /yang rin chen 'bru gsum dang / yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse la gdags/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /pu hrangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum grol/ dbus pa lnga drug lam sna zin pa yin skad/ de nas shab kyi sna rings na gnas brtan glan chen po bya ba chos rgyus che ba'i dpon grag po gcig yod pas/ shab kyi snyi tshar gdan drangs te chu mig skor gyi dge bshes chen po du mas dbang gdams ngag mang du zhus/ g.yas ru dang ru lag gi sngags btsun rnal 'byor pa chen pos thug med kyi sku drin zhus/ smin grol lam du chud pa'i bka' drin thob pa mtha' yas so/

/de nas chu mig ring mor spyan drangs te dge bshes brgya lhag gcig la btsun pa stong tsho gsum tsam gyis bskor ba'i bsu ba dang ston mo chen po mdzad/ zla ba phyed tsam du bzhugs nas chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod mu mtha' med pa byas/ rdo rje lam rim dang / skyes bu bzhi'i lam rim dang / zung 'jug bzhi la sogs pa gsungs/ de nas tshong 'dus mgur mor byon nas zla ba gsum bzhugs te/ 'gro ba mtho dman bar gsum gyi don bsam gyis mi lang pa mdzad/ dge bshes chen po tshad med pas gtso mdzad de/ dbang byin rlabs 'jug sgo dpag tu med pa yang mdzad/ sdom 'dzin dang / sems bskyed dang / rgyas gdab zhus pa la grangs med pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rgya/ 'bre/ lam/ lo ngo / gshen/ drug la sogs pas zab don gyi bstan bcos zhus pas/ rnal 'byor bdun dang sems kyi mdud grol la sogs pa mdzad/ der ma tshar ba 'ga' zhig yar gshegs shul du yang khrid nas rgya cher bskyangs so/ /ya gi rgya gar/ kha che/ bal yul nas bzung ste/ smad khams gsum me nyag dang / rgya khri stan gyi bar du dngos dang brgyud nas chos dang zang zing gis phan thogs ma byas pa ni phal cher med/ yun ring por nye gnas byas pa'i slob dpon nyi ma bya bas grangs brtsis pas/ mgur mo yan chad nas/ la stong thang chung gi bar du grwa pa brgya yan chad skyong ba'i dge bshes nyis stong sum brgya tsam rjes su gzung gda' skad/ de man chad bgrang gis mi lang ngo / /'dir tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ lar gdul bya rab 'bring ji snyed du/ 'dul byed mdzad pa'i rim pa yang / /de snyed bzhin de blor mi shong / /sdon chad bod 'dir yong ma byung / /'di ltar bod kyi rgyal khams na/ /gdul bya'i las 'brel ma bzhag pa/ /log seng can las med par nges/ /rje mai tra 'chi med bdud rtsi la/ cher 'thungs cher ni rgyal 'gyur la/ /chung 'thungs chung ni rgyal 'gyur te/

/ye tshogs sog cig bskal pa chad/ /gang zhig nga la ma dad pas/ /skur 'debs logs par smra ba yang / /phyis nas 'gyod cing slar dad nas/ /smin pa'i gdul byar 'gyur ro gsungs/ de ltar dngos dang sa bon gyis/ /byang phyogs skye bo'i don bsgrubs nas/ /zang zing sgyu ma'i 'du ba la/ /chags thogs med par phyir la log /bya ngang pa'i rjes su ngang phrug bzhin/ /yang ni rjes 'bangs zhabs tog byas/ /gser phye srang grangs kyi maṇḍal phul/ /'du 'bral med par gsol ba btab/ /skyes mchog zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /mig 'bral ma phod ring zhig bltas/ /snying khong nas gdung pa'i mes bzhus pas/ /chu mig nas lhung ba'i mchi ma shor/ /pha grub chen seng ge'i lta stangs kyis/ /brda skye med bstan pas dran pa rnyed/ /rang sems bla mar bstan pa dran/ /'du 'bral med par nga gdong sleb/ /der rjes zhal chems tshig gsum zhus/ /bsgo ba thun mong ma yin pa/ /rgyal sras mdzad pa'i rnam thar la/ /snying po mdor bsdus kyi zhal chems gsungs/ /de la don gsum mdor bsdus la/ /dpe gsum rim pa bzhin du gnas/ /khri btson mo gsham bran mo ltar/ /gdung bas lha dang bla ma bsten/ /yongs su bzung ba kun spang zhing / /skyo med nga rgyal med par byas/ /ji skad bstan pa'i zhal chems 'di/ /bu khyod tshul bzhin sgrub spyod na/ /ring du song yang drung na 'dug /nam yang 'bral ba med do gsung / /gsung 'di dag dal bus bsnyad nas ni/ /zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i smin mtshams nas/ /'od zer kun da lta bu cig /kho bo'i spyi gtsug reg thim snyam/ /skad cig de la se gol btog /siddhi siddhi zhes gsungs nas/ khra hor pa gzan la gzhungs pa bzhin/ slar rgya gar yul du gshegs nas thal/ de nas zhabs 'bring ba bod mi lnga bcu tsam yod pa ni mthil nas log rgya gar ba sum brgya tsam gyis g.yog byas te/ bal yul du yun cang ma thogs par rgya gar du zad de gshegs so/

/ti ra hu ti'i nye 'khor nas mtha' 'khob pa'i jag pas yul log byas kyang zer/ a tsa ra'i g.yog gis bslus sam yang zer/ kha cig a tsa ra'i g.yog pa'i gseb nas nang byan byas nas phyi'i mtha' 'khob pas grong log byas so zer te rje btsun bkrongs nas gser thams cad khyer ro/ /de yang bal yul gyi gnas pos rje btsun la zhus te/ rgya gar gyi lam 'di mi ngan jag pa kha snyogs thug med yod pas gser phag tu 'khyer ba'i thabs gcig 'tshal lo zhes zhus pas/ gser gzhu ba tsho gnod sbyin ka pa la bskur/ ma gzhu ba'i sbram rnams dang gla rtsi dang dar zab dang g.yu chung legs legs tsho bhi ka la la bskur bas chog gsung ngo / /gnas po'i bsam pa la khong grub thob yin pas btub ste 'ong / de ma yin na cha med do snyam pa las/ chen po'i gsung yin pas zlog ma nus so/ /nye gnas pa ra u tra bya ba dang / su ri sa bya ba gnyis yod pa la/ ra u tra ma ga dha pa yin pas ma ga dha'i rgyal po bsu ba la sbran na legs zer su ris yangs pa can pa yin pas yangs pa can gyi rgyal po bsu ba la sbran na legs zer ro/ /rje'i zhal nas/ bha ri e ka dza ṭi bya ba'i rgyal po gcig yod pas ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i dod/ ḍā ki thod pa'i phreng ba can bya ba gcig sbran na yangs pa can gyi rgyal po'i dod/ ḍā ki ni rdo rje'i phreng ba can bya ba gcig sbran gyis gsung skad/ gaṅgā la nye ba'i 'gram du phyin pa na/ lha se ma sa li bya ba'i grong dang / ti tir gur bya ba'i grong tshan gnyis kyi yul log byas te/ rje btsun gyi sku stod sku smad phral/ dbu phog nas bye ma'i gseb tu sbas/ nor thams cad khyer te jag pa rnams so sor gyes so/ /yongs su grags pa la mai tra yo gi grub thob yin pas bsad kyang mi 'chi/ gal te shi yang sos nas 'ong bya ba'i grags pa yod pas/ sku stod sku smad gnyis so sor shing ke la'i sdong po'i rkang chen po gcig dang gso thag ring pos dkris te ya gi ma gir bskyur ro/

/de nas zhag gsum nas stod smad bar gsum 'dus nas gcer bur dngos su byung skad/ jag pa rnams la zan blangs te/ jag pas khyer ba'i nor thams cad gar song cha med du song ba las/ slar khong rang gi phyag tu 'dus nas gso phad kyi nang du btums te dbyug pa'i ngos gnyis su bkal nas spyugs glu len zhing song skad/ glu ni rgya gar na tshur glu mkhan rnams kyis zer sgra khyer nas byung ba yang mang du snang ste ma dag pa bag re snang / phyis u rgyan gyi paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzras gtan la phab nas byon pa ni 'di yin te/ e ma e ma e ma ho/ /mai tra yo gi sgyu ma'i mi/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'khrul 'khor bshig /'khrul 'khor bshig pa'i ro la ltos/ /mgo bo go tra'i ral gris bcad/ /mgo bo gti mug dag pa'i ro/ /ro de bye ma'i rlom du sbas/ /gti mug rnam par mi rtog zhi/ /khog stod ti shi li yis bcad/ /khog stod zhe sdang dag pa'i ro/ /ro de ma sa li pas khyer/ /zhe sdang 'od gsal me chen 'bar/ /khog smad ro hi khyung 'dras bcad/ /khog smad 'dod chags dag pa'i ro/ /ro de gaṅgā'i chu la skyur/ /'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /mi bzad mtshon gyis dral ba'i tshe/ /zug rngu stong pa'i ngang du 'bar/ /zug rngu tshor ba tshor bas stong / /gnyis med kyi ye shes 'u ru ru/ /zhes gsung skad/ de nas dpal gyi ri'i phyogs bzhi na sgo bzhi yod pa'i mtshams rnams na 'brog dgon pa ya nga ba mang po rnams su lha khang dang mgron khang mang po btsugs/ khyad par du o ti pa'i yul du jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba'i lta khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs so/ /de ltar lo lnga lon nas bal yul gyi rnal 'byor pa gnyis dang / ya thā su khi …bde mtshon gnyis te/ bzhis mahā bo dhir bskor ba la phyin pa dang lam du rje btsun dang mjal te ya thā su khi bal yul du byon pa'i tshe/

gnas po dang slob ma yin pas gsung gleng zhib rgyas su byung / lan gcig bkrongs nas byon pa'i lo rgyus rnams byung bas/ mgron po bzhi bos zhus pa thengs gcig bal yul du cis kyang 'byon par zhu 'tshal/ bkrongs nas med do bya ba'i grags pa ngan pas khyab pa dang / zang zing phul ba dang / gdams ngag zhus pa tsho the tshom skyes pa mang bas zhes rgyas par zhu phul/ da lta zla ba gcig gi khongs su bal yul dang nye ba'i ka ma tsar tsi bya bar 'ong gis gsungs/ phyis gtam brgyud pas de kho na bzhin byon nas/ rgya gar dang bha ro slob mar gyur pa mang po dang mjal/ khro phur yang 'phrin bskur bas sleb par byung ngo / /rje btsun mai tra grub chen gyis rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus so// ༈ //bla ma paṇa chen buddha shrīs rjes su bzung lugs la/ paṇa chen dang mjal lugs dang bsten lugs phal cher ni brjod zin la/ gdan drangs tshul ni/ bla ma paṇa chen de'i yab ni kha che ba yin/ yum ni rgya gar mo yin/ khong nyid bal yul mthil gyi kho pom bha bhya gra mar sku 'khrungs pa yin no/ /de rjes rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par sbyangs nas/ rgya gar gyi bi ka ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang chen po na shin tu rtsis che bar bzhugs/ dge 'dun phal chen pa las rab tu gshegs pas phal chen sde pa'i bu slob yang rgya cher rgyas par gyur/ de nyid du rtag tu bzhugs 'dod pa yin pa la/ bla ma bi khyu ta de ba …slong mo ba'i lha zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta'i grub thob gcig rtsa ba'i bla mar bzhugs pas/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa rgyas par zhus te/ rdo rje theg pa'i bdag por gyur to/ /de nas rje bi khyu ta de nyid la bal yul mthil gyi ta pa sī dang / ha du rnams dang / kho khom gyi rgyal pos paṇa chen de'i snyan pa thos nas/ pho nya yang yang brdzangs te/ bal yul gyi chos ston pa'i paṇḍi tar gsol ba btab/ ram ga na bhi ri ha la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang gsar pa cha gsum gyi rab gnas kyang rgyas pa gcig mdzad par zhus pas/

rdo rje gdan pa chen po de'i zhal nas/ nga shin tu rgas pas bal yul du mi bgrod/ nga'i 'og tu mkhas shing bzang pa bu'i dam pa paṇḍi ta 'di yin pas gtong zhes gsungs te/ chos 'chad pa'i paṇḍi ta la rje paṇa chen 'di springs/ rab gnas rgyang nas mdzad cing cho ga rgyas par yang paṇa chen gyis mdzad/ paṇḍi ta'i grub thob de rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas bal yul nas rgya gar gyi bar du bar ma chad par 'brel ba'i 'bul ba btang ba yin skad/ bod du byon pa'i 'bul ba'i phud kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i gdan sa mahā bo dhir gser srang brgya'i cha rkyen phul/ bi kra ma la shi lar chos 'chad pa'i/ khri phyogs bzhir glang po che bzhi'i mgo steng du seng chen khros pa'i sbar ba g.yon gyis mnan nas sbar ba g.yas gyen du gdengs pa byas/ lugs ma la tsha gser gyis byugs pa bzo rigs khyad par can de lta bu gcig phul/ de lta bu gnyis byas pa'i ya gcig thang bhi ha ra na da lta yang bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe 'dzam bu gling gi chos grwa yongs su grags pas khyab par gleng ba ni shrī rnam gnyis zhes bya ba/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i paṇḍi ta gnyis yin pa las/ nyi ma lta bu'i chos rje shākya shrī rgya gar na bzhugs/ zla ba lta bu'i paṇa chen buddha shrī bal yul mthil na bzhugs so/ /lo tsā bas paṇa chen buddha shrī …sangs rgyas dpal de lo hril po lnga bar ma chad par gus shing dang bas bsten nas/ sngon du rgyal ba'i yum mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel gsar la sogs pa dang / sngags kyi rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa'i phyag bzhes khyad par can dar bar bya rgyu yod pas paṇa chen de nyid sngon la gdan 'dren pa'i rtsis yin pa la/ rje btsun mai tra byon pas/ paṇa chen de nyid na re/ nga'i bla ma khong yin/ 'gro ba byin po 'dul ba la rje btsun 'di bsngags/ khyod lha chen po bzhengs pa la sngon dus 'dul ba dang / bsod nams dang / khog chen po bca' dgos pas rje btsun 'di sngon du gdan drongs shig rje btsun gyis sngon las btul nas 'ur langs pa'i rjes su/

nga 'ongs la sngags dang mtshan nyid gang don du 'gyur ba bstan nas phan gdags so gsung bas de kho na bzhin byas so/ /rje btsun grub chen phar gshegs nas lo bzhi na lcags pho spre'u'i lo la rje paṇa chen gdan drangs te/ khong nyid kyi lo rtags kyang lugs pho spre'u yin/ drug cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa la byon no/ /lo tsā ba skyid grong 'phags pa'i drung du 'dug nas skye bo'i tshogs la chos spyod yan lag bzhi ba nas brtsams te/ rin chen 'bru dgu dang / bstan pa'i gru la sogs pa bshad/ gnas bzhi dang yon bdag pa'i grong khyer thams cad kyis zhabs tog dpe med pa mang po byas so/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten phul ba rnams 'phags pa'i pho brang du phul/ bsnyen bkur gyi phud kyis mar me chen po'i phreng ba phreng brgyud rtag tu phul/ zang zing phul ba rnams kyis/ chos pa dang / mi chos pa dang / mgron po la sogs pa tshim par byas/ g.yu chen po khyung gshog bya ba dang / gser sbram seng ge nyal ba bya ba jo bo'i mgul du btags/ /lha rje ra phyar la sogs pa bang chen pa bzhi mthil du gdan 'dren pa la springs te gsol 'debs kyi maṇḍal la gser g.yu'i maṇḍal tshom bu nyi shu rtsa lnga pa bskur/ gser srang nyis brgya dang / sum cu tham pa 'bul ba'i cha don byas so/ /'phags pa la zhag bdun mchod pa byas pa'i rjes su paṇa chen de nyid 'byon mi 'byon dang / ji tsam na 'byon pa'i rmi ltas brtags te/ bdag ni dpag med rang gzhan don sgrub phyir/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo gdan drangs na/ /ji ga byon nam 'on te mi byon zhes/ /kho bo'i yid ni the tshom dra bas gzings/ /zhes bya ba las sogs pa'i gsol 'debs bkod pas spyir byon par nges pa dang / zhag grangs 'di tsam la byon bya ba'i bye brag rmi ltas kyis shes par byung nas sna len dang bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya cher byas/ paṇa chen nyid kyis 'phags pa byams pa grong khyer du byon pa ngo mtshar can gcig skyes su gdan drangs nas byon/

da lta dga' ldan gyi pho brang lho ma na bzhugs pa de yin no/ /mthil gyi gnas pos kyang gser gdugs dang do li khra mo dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dang / phyi rol gyi bzhugs khang gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa phyogs mtshon rol cha du ma dang bcas pa dang / nang du bzhugs khang 'grib yol dang mchod cha sna tshogs kyi bkod pa dang bcas pa bskur byung ngo / /de nas skyid grong du btsun pa phyug po gcig dang kan 'jim gyi yon bdag gra ma kha cig 'dus pas chos 'khor zhus/ rgyal ba'i yum brgyad stong pa la slob dpon seng bzang dang / a bhya ka ra'i gsung bgros gnyis ka gsungs so/ /dbus pa'i ston pa ka gsum pa bya ba mkhas pa gnyis kyis zhus nas rgya gar dzñān shrī'i tshad ma rab tu byed pa bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'i gnyis gsungs/ de'i dus su paṇḍi ta thams cad mkhyen pa bya ba de rten dge bsnyen gzhon nu gcig yod pas/ paṇa chen gyi klog 'dzin pa byas/ tshogs pa spyi chos su dpe'i rgya mtsho dang rgyu 'bras kyi rnam dbye gnyis gsungs/ rgyal ba'i lam 'jug gi gzhung tshar bar byas so/ /dus bzang la 'phags pa byams pa rgya cher lung bstan pa'i mdo gsungs pas skye bo phal po che dad de da gdod bzhengs par 'gyur ba'i sku la zangs spyad nang sal sil mang po phul/ dbu'i tshad kyi skya ris gcig bzhengs par zhu phul nas/ 'phags pa wa ti'i lha khang gi rgyab tu bri bar zhus so/ /paṇa chen gyi zhal nas 'o na ltas brtag pa dang thabs gcig tu bya'o gsungs te/ me tog las sogs pa'i mchod pa mang po dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang / bla ma chen po la gtor ma'i rdzas mang po dang bcas pas byin rlabs zhus zhing gsol ba btab/ lha bzo ba bsnyen gnas dang ldan par byas te/ sku'i zhal tshad bri ba'i phyir rtsig ngos la byug pa byas pa'i tshe nyid glo bur du sa g.yos ba byung / paṇa chen thugs dam la bzhugs pas ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'bad ma dgos pa byung skad/

nga la 'di lta bu'i bya ba chen po rtsom pa na grub na ba spu g.yo ba bya ba'i dge ltas gcig yod de/ da res g.yo ba tsam du ma zad par ba sbu 'greng ba yang byung / sems rang dbang med par dga' zhing dang ba rtse gcig tu gnas pa gsum 'dzom pa byung / don 'di 'grub par thag chod pa yin gyis the tshom ma byed cig ces pa yang yang gsung ngo / /yang de'i tshe na ngo mtshar can gyi ltas bdun mngon du gyur pa byung ba la tshigs su bcad pa/ paṇa chen zhal nas sngon tshe kho bo'i don/ /'grub 'gyur dge ba'i ltas gang yin pa de/ /bu khyod bsod nams dbang gis 'di byung gis/ /rten 'di mi 'grub snyam ba'i the tshom ma byed gsungs/ /lha bzo blo mig can de'ang de ma thag /pir bzung tsam gyis lus kun ba spu 'khrugs/ /ring po mi thogs dga' ldan mthong snyam du/ /sngon chad ma byung bde dga' rangs pa skyes/ /de tshe bdag kyang rtse gcig yid dang ste/ /lus ni shing bal ltar yang bde ba dang / /lha la rab dang 'gro la brtse ba'i blo/ /mchi mas rdzi dkrugs rang dbang med par gyur/ mchod phyir myur lhags sgeg mdzes dul ba yi/ /mtshar chags na chung zur mig lta ba dag /phyur chags dri bsung kha dog sna tshogs kyis/ /me tog snod thogs dga' bas stob par byed/ /don gnyer mgron po glo bur lhags rnams la/ /khyed cig don kun 'grub bam ma 'grub ces/ /glo bur dag gis ltas ni brtags pas kyang / /ji bzhin 'dod gyur 'grub ces gsal po smras/ /rgyang ring nas 'ongs rab gus mi gnyis zhig /mthong bas don grub bzhin du rkang la btud/ /lag gnyis kha bye 'bras bus gang ba ni/ /yon 'bul bzhin du kho bo'i phang na gnas/ /de zhal tshar nas spyan gnyis 'byed pa na/ /char sprin mthug 'khrigs rgyun ring zab mo yis/ /'brug sgra snyan sgrogs glog phreng gar byed cing / /dri zhim rdzi bskyod rab mdzes char rgyun phab/

/ltas bdun ya mtshan mngon sum gyur pa 'di/ /bdag yid mi zhum dpa' bor byos shig brda/ /ltas bdun la sogs ston par mdzad pa'i rje/ /lhar bcas sras gnyis bla ma mchog la 'dud/ /de nas bung thang du spyan drangs te/ dgun 'da' dang / rgyal po'i khab dang / glang ri ba dang / ro mnyam pa dang / yang thog pa dang / gseb kyi skya mo ba la sogs pas chos 'khor rim pa rim par btsugs/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs rab gnas mang po zhus/ la las sems bskyed/ la las dam tshig gso ba la sogs pa mang du zhus/ khyad par du ro skam bdud rtsi bde ldan du/ rgyud bla ma'i ṭī ka rgyas par brtsams/ gtsug lag khang gi bya ba la gdams pa bya ba dang / chos spyod brgya rtse man ngag bsgyur/ de nas gung thang gi bar la rgal te dpal thang lho dang byang gnyis kar gdan drangs nas skye bo dpag tu med pa thar lam la bkod/ gtsang pa dang cung ba la sogs par 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas/ don mo rir chos 'khor yun ring bar mdzad/ stag tsho'i dpon gyis zhabs tog mang du byas te rim gyis 'phrang brag dmar nas byar ru la gor yun ring du bzhugs/ shab dar khang dang dar lung la sogs par chos mang du gsungs shing bstan bcos mang po yang brtsams/ khro phur byon nas sgrub pa po dang rnal 'byor pa'i chos rigs la mos pa mang po 'dus pa rnams la rang rang gi skal ba dang bstun pa'i chos bstan/ lung rigs man ngag gsum ka'i chos du ma zhig gtan la phab ste zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs so/ /de'i rjes la chu mig ring mo dang tshong 'dus mgur mor spyan drangs te gzhung che chung rnam pa du ma gsungs so/ /de nas dbus su gdan 'dren mang po yod pa la/ lo tsā ba lha chen bzhengs pa'i lha gon gyis brel ba dang / paṇa chen de nyid kyis bsdus pa'i grogs mched dge bshes chag lo tsā ba bya ba rgya gar du yang byon/ paṇa chen de nyid yun ring du bsten yang bod du byon pa la paṇḍi ta gdan 'dren pa'i rten 'brel ma 'grig pa gcig bzhugs pa la 'phrin pa btang nas/

'o skol lha chen po bzhengs pa'i bya ba ches pas paṇa chen gyi rdzongs grub par dka'/ khyed kyis dbus su gdan drangs nas rdzongs srang nyis brgya sum cu po mdzad na legs sam gros byas pas/ shin tu dgyes te de kho na ltar bya'o zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang bla ma de 'o skol la sku drin shin tu che ba yin pas gser srang lnga'i maṇḍal dang / g.yu rdog chen po 'dzam gling rgyan bya ba gser srang lnga bcu ri pa gcig lhag par phul/ de phyis bsam yas kyi btsad po la btsongs pas srang phyed dang nyis brgya'i bcad pa la song 'dug skad/ mgur mor tshong pa'i bha ro rnams kyis chos 'khor btsugs nas mdo sde rgyan dang dbu ma rtsa sher gsungs/ rgya bod bal gsum yid rangs par gyur to/ /dge bshes chag los paṇa chen dbu ru dang g.yor po gnyis kar gdan drangs nas lo phyed dang gnyis bzhugs/ khyad par du chag lo tsā ba'i yul gnyal ba yin pas gnyal gyi 'phral ster la sogs par gdan drangs nas rgyal ba'i lam 'jug mang du gsungs skad/ yar byon pa'i tshe nyang shab nas bsus nas skyid grong gi lam nas bal yul gyi bar du zhabs tog legs par byas/ mar gshegs khar dpal dus 'khor gyi gdams pa khyad par can de gnang ngo / /nga'i gzhung dang man ngag sngar gzhan la ma grags pa 'di rnams cis kyang dar bar gyis shig ces gsungs/ spyan chab dang bcas pas byin rlabs rgyas par mdzad de gshegs so/ /paṇa chen gdan 'dren pa'i gsol 'debs dang / sems bskyed gsol 'debs bo dong bya rgod gshongs kyi jo bo thugs rje chen po dang rnam sras mdung dmar can la zhus pa yin pas lo tsā bas phar bla ma bskyal nas mar log pa'i tshe bo dong bya rgod gshongs kyi pho brang du gtang rag gi mchod pa phul/ phyogs rnams ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs rje las/ sku bltams 'gro kun yid bzhin nor gcig pu/ /gzhan tshon 'brug sgra gangs ri'i tshul 'chang ba'i/

/thugs gsung sku yi sa 'di rab 'byams bsrungs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnam thar dang bstun pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa gcig gtang rag tu byas so/ /paṇa chen buddha shrīs rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus so// ༈ //bla ma paṇa chen shākya shrīs rjes su bzung lugs ni/ sngon grwa pa gzhon nu'i dus na snyan pa thos pas dad pa drag po yod kyang thag ring bas mjal ba'i rten 'brel ma 'dzoms/ phyis dus zhig na/ bla ma bdud rtsi zhig pos rdo rje gdan du mchod pa 'bul du btang ba'i bla ma shag dar dang rgya gar ba bya ba/ yul nyang ston pa'i rtogs ldan go chod pa gnyis yod pa la gser shas gcig bskur nas chos rje bod du gdan drangs sam ltar btang ba ltas ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bzung bas bcings pa ltar song ba dang / bu gces bsad pa'i ma gcig lceb 'phro la bzung nas bu'i dod du khas blangs pa rgas shing 'khogs par song ba gcig gso dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis byon pa'i thabs ma rnyed do/ /de nas bang chen pa gnyis pos bal yul mthil du rje btsun byams pa'i zhabs mgo gnyis dang / chos 'chad kyi phyag mgo gcig byas so/ /de nas bzung ba'i lo bcu gcig nas phyis chos rje bod du byon par gda' skad/ bar skabs der rang lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa la/ dbus kyi 'bri khung du/ rje 'bri khung pa dang mjal/ de'i lam du rin po che stag lung thang pa dang mjal/ rje stag lung pas kyang sku drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa zang zing dang / chos zab mo gnyis kas thugs la btags/ 'bri khung du phar la dad pa sgom zhing gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du zhal mthong / rgyang ring po nas spyil po rnams mthong bas ya mtshan skyes/ rgya gar ba'i rdo sku mdzad pa brgyad pa ngo mtshar che ba gcig sku'i rten du phul/ rin po che'i brgyad stong pa yi ge la 'bur mang po yod pa glegs shing la brkos rgyan du ma dang bcas pa zhig gsung gi rten du phul/

li bzo'i rdo rje gzong brkos ma bse'i ga'u can rtsis can gcig thugs kyi rten du phul/ chibs pa bzang po gnyis dar yug 'ga' dang bcas te phyag tu btang bas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bcas pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin gsungs nas mnyes/ ling yug dkar po bzang po gcig tshur la phyag rten du gnang ste/ dkar po'i chos kyi 'phrin las thams cad dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig gsungs/ bsu ba chen po dang sna len ston mo 'bogs dang bcas pa gnang nas zhag 'ga' zhig lon pa dang / mkhas pa'i bde gcad dgos pas tshogs su chos gtam 'ga' zhig mdzad par zhu gsungs/ de kho na bzhin du zhu byas te dge 'dun khri tsho mang du 'dus pa'i gung la khri chen po bshams nas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi ston pa bzang dgu lnga bcu tsam gyis dris pa'i lan btab pas thams cad yid rangs par gyur/ tshar nas gzims khang du bos/ bgro gleng rgyal ba'i gtang rag yin no gsungs te/ ting bkrol chen po dang bcas pa'i dar brgya 'bog cig gnang / der zla ba lnga dang zhag bcur sems bskyed lan grangs mang po dang / zab chos sna tshogs dang / nyid kyi khyad chos kyi zhing du ma dang bcas pa gnang / byams chen gyi skyil krung 'dir bzhengs la/ phyis dum bu rnams mdzo la bkal la yar gdan drongs/ zhes gsungs nas 'bri khung gi thang la skyil krung gi tshad ru shing btsugs/ yang de'i tshe ltas brtag pa las byung ba'i dngos po tshigs su bcad pa ni/ gang tshe rigs byung chos 'byor bod yul dbus/ /dbu ru byang phyogs dam pa'i pho brang ni/ /dpal ldan 'bri khung zhes byar gang song tshe/ /chos rje des dgongs bkra shis 'di dag mthong / /gzhi der gser yum zhal sprod yig 'bri ba/ /rang dgar 'tshams bzhag mthong las 'di skad du/ /de dag gis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba dag /'bar ba skyed par rig par bya zhes byung / der rjes 'jig rten mgon po'i drung de nyid/

/ring nas gus lhags bshes gnyen chen po zhig /sbrang rtsi pad mos rab brgyan phul byas nas/ da dung ji tsam dgos dgos 'byung zhes zer/ /de ma thag der dge 'dun kun bsdus nas/ /mchod rdzas kun bkod mchod dbyangs sgra cher bsgrags/ /sku gzugs mchod rten phan yon ston pa'i mdo/ /rnam mangs ched du brjod pas ched du brjod/ /de nas chos rgyal chos rab bdud rtsi'i ros/ /thugs bltams ngo mtshar shes rab snying rje las/ /brtsams te sku dang gsung dang mchod rten tshogs/ /mang zhing rab gnas cho ga rgyas par 'chad/ /de 'og bstan pa'i sgron chen rin chen bkas/ /rab bskul byams chen rus khog rdo rje'i rmad/ /bzhag gyur skad cig de la sprin rum dkrigs/ /'brug sgra snyan sgrogs glog 'gyu char rgyun 'bab/ /de rjes rgyal yum rin chen rgyas bsdus dag /'bul phyir skyil krung steng du stob pa bzhin/ /shis pa'i dung 'bud dpal gyi dar 'phyar zhing / /dge legs rnga brdungs bdug pa'i sprin tshogs bstibs/ /bkren chen bdag la sbyor ba'i mthu med kyang / /byams chen sras ni thugs rje che yin pas/ /de sprul chos rje rin chen thugs dgongs te/ /gser dngul dar zab khur chen rjes gnang rmad/ /'di dag ni 'bri khung du mngon du gyur ba'i ltas rnam pa bdun yin no/ /de nas bya yul dang rin chen sgang la sogs par chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod mang po byung / jo bo phyag stong spyan stong la bzhugs tshul dang bstun pa'i bstod pa phul/ yar 'phrang gi yi ge drug pa la bltas te mchod bstod byas nas gsol ba btab/ tshal gung thang du bsu ba dang mchod mgron bzang po mdzad cing thugs la btags/ zhang rin po che la sngon nas mos gus drag po yod pas gsol ba cher btab ste gzims khang du nyal bas rmi lam du khong nyid kyis chos chung thams cad kyi bshad lung dang / sgrub lung gnyis ka gnang ngo /

/dge 'dun zhal rags pa la ja bskol te mchod khang du mar me chen po phul nas/ bsam mi khyab chen po bya ba'i bstod pa phul/ de dang nye ba na/ lha shākya rnam gnyis bzhugs pa la mchod cing bskor ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa la zla ba gnyis bsdad nas lha chen bzhengs pa'i don du gsol ba mang du btab/ shin tu rmad byung rgyu lam 'bras bcas kyi/ /'gro la rtag tu phan sbyor bde sbyin pa/ /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po lha khyod la/ /dang bas phyag 'tshal 'dir mdzad cha tsam bstod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa sngon byung tshul nas brgyud pa'i bstod pa phul/ lha chen grub par gsol ba btab/ brag lhar yang gsol ba btab pas 'od byung nas sgrol ma'i thang ka gcig la thim pa mthong ba mang po'i mthun snang du byung / de nas 'phrul snang du bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo'i yig sna de brtsams so/ /'phrul snang du jo bo shākya nyid dang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rang byung gnyis la mchod cing bskor ba mang du byas te gsol ba btab pa ni/ 'gro mgon shākya'i gtso dang spyan ras gzigs/ /bcu gcig zhal mnga' bdag la 'dir dgongs gsol/ /khyod sras ma byon sangs rgyas byams mgon la/ /dad thob de yi sku chen bzhengs par 'tshal/ /rab 'bul bdag la gang gis ro sbyin pa'i/ /dpal mgon khyod sras yab bcas min ma mchis/ /de bas phongs pa kun gyis gter gcig bu/ /khyod la gdungs pas gsol 'debs thugs rjes bzung / /nyid thugs bu la pha ltar rtag dgongs mod/ /snyigs dus skye bo rab tu skal ngan la/ /bdag kyang rang nyid nyes pas mthu med na/ /de slad de bas ches khyod thugs dgongs mdzod/ /dus 'di'ang da dung khyod kyis bstan lags na/ /brlabs chen don yang nyid mthu med mi 'grub/ /bdag sogs 'di don dka' spyad stong dag gis/ /brnag bgyid dal ba 'di dag gzigs mdzad gsol/ /sngon tshe khyod nyid sbyar ba spyod mdzad tshe/

/bzod dka'i tshor ba stong phrag brnag mdzad de/ /'gro skyabs gyur nas nyams thag dbugs dbyung zhes/ /zhal bzhes tshad ma'i skyes bur mdzod cig lha/ /blo brdol bum par nam mkha'i char 'thigs bzhin/ /khyod la ma thogs bdag skyon lags gsungs drang / /de bsal thabs nyid kun rmongs bdag la 'dir/ /gzhan med khyod kyis zhal sngar blta bar bas/ /mdor na rang nyid nongs pa gang gis bdag /dbul gyur dgra chen de nyid gzhom gsol zhing / /mkha' khyab smon lam mthar phyin 'gyur ba shog /khyad par skabs 'dir bde myur 'bras bcas mdzod/ /srid na re gnas lha gzhan ma mchis la/ /bdag ni rgud pa'i dgras zin bya ba 'di'ang / /don chen lags mod 'dir don mdzad mi mdzad/ /mkhyen brtse thabs ldan khyed nyid dgongs par zad/ /ces bya ba'o/ /de nas lha sa nas stod lungs su spyan drangs te/ ra mo che nas rgyab ma dang 'brog mo la sogs par phyin/ bongs dang / lcib phu la sogs par grub thob kun bzang gi yum sras la sogs zhabs tog cher byas/ khrus chog thebs re la yang rta dang / nas 'bul ba mang du byung / par phu dang / mon gra dang / cang ra dang / skyer sgang la sogs par lha chos dang mi chos gnyis ka'i don rgya cher byas ta ེ/ mtshur phu'i mdo bo la sogs pas mchod cing bsnyen bkur nas/ gzhu snyi nas rong dang / nyang stod la sogs pa thams cad du gzhan don dang rang don lha'i cha rkyen dang bcas pa mang pos phan btags so/ /rang lo sum cu rtsa drug lon pa'i tshe/ chos rje shākya shrī rgya gar shar phyogs nas gdan drangs te/ de yang shab stod dar lungs bya ba na gnas brtan ston rgyan bya bas gson shing la dge bshes mang du gdan drangs pa'i mchod mgron gyi gtso bo byas so/ /de'i dus su lho sgo'i spa dro gcal ka bya ba na/ bla ma gnyos rin po che bzhugs pa'i sar/ rgya gar shar phyogs dza gha dha la bi hā ra …'gro lan gyi gtsug lag khang bya ba na chos rje shākya shrī bzhugs pa'i drung nas paṇa chung dza ya shrī …rgyal ba dpal dang pradzñā shrī bya ba gnyis kha cher 'gro ba'i lam bod nas 'gro bar 'dod de bod du 'ongs pa'i lam du mtha' 'khob/

chu 'ug pa dang kos mcho ba'i mi sdes bran du khyer te zla ba 'ga' zhig tu nyam thag par byas/ de nas bros pas sba dro'i mthar thon nas spa dro ba'i tshong pa dang phrad de kha che ba gnyis po nyos nas gnyos rin po che la phul lo/ /gnyos kyi drung nas khams pa gnyis 'bri khung du 'gro ba'i lam du/ chos 'khor gyi sa der byung ba la/ lo tsā ba la gtad pa dang / ma ga dhar gar log byung bas chos rje yang shar phyogs su 'phags te dza gha dha la na bzhugs/ de nas bhe dhur tshong 'dus shin tu nye ba'i gtam thos nas yid dga' ba dang 'dod pa drag tu skyes so/ /de nyid kyi tshe dar lung kyi chos 'khor thon nas shab dar sgang bya bar me tog bsdus pa'i sar 'phos pa dang / tshes bcu'i dus gcig la slebs pa dang 'dzoms nas/ nang gi gtor ma gcig bshams nas chos rje gdan drangs na 'dren nam mi 'dren gyi rmi ltas brtags so/ /rmi lam du shel gyi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang mi gzugs kyi spangs gsum mam lnga tsam yod pa zhig la zur cung zad nyams pa gcig rnyed nas dar gyi the gu'am/ res bso thag yin pa snyam pa'ang byed pa'i the gus 'then pa las/ gang du 'then par byung ste/ res 'ga' grog po la yang mi sdug par rgyangs rgyangs byung / res thang bde ba la yang go le thogs par byung / res g.yang sa chen po la yang mi thogs par 'phyong zhing byung / cung zad zur nyams pa de la/ pho dang zhes bya ba lugs chad pa la lugs tshab 'dzud pa bzhin du/ zla ba phyed phyed na so so thar pa'i mdo 'don pa'i dod ye dharma'i sngags zlos pa'o/ /phag mig zhes bya phag mig ltar skabs skabs su bka' bkyon drag po 'ong bas phag mig ltar spyan gru gsum ston pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'i lo rgyus kyang byung ngo / /nang par don 'grub par shes nas de'i chos mtshams bzung ste/ gro mo'i lam nas rgya gar shar phyogs nas gdan 'dren pa'i sta gon la zhugs so/

/chos 'khor gyi rgyags me tog nas kyis gser btsal bas ye ma rnyed/ dge 'dun 'dus pa mang du 'ongs pa la ja mang bskol byas te/ chos rje shākya shrī gdan 'dren du 'gro bas gser 'bul ba yod na shin tu legs/ 'bul ba med na skyin por byung yang go bcad do zhes dril bsgrags pa las/ phal cher gyis ha har byas te gdan 'dren du 'gro ba'i grags pa ni rgya cher khyab/ gser ni zho gnyis las ma byung ngo / /de nyid kyi tshe dpon tshe tsha bya ba shab kyi sgo lnga rigs gsum na 'khrug pa pham pas zug khang du 'chugs te/ /sngo nyal bas mtha' skor nas nang btson du bsdams pa 'don pa la sbron du byung ste/ mtshan mo brgyugs nas chos gos dang phyam tshe la sogs pas g.yogs shing phyir bton pas mi gces rang gi lo grangs tsam gyi srog bton/ de ma thag rgya gar gyi lam du zhugs te shing pho byi ba'i lo rta zla'i tshes bdun gyi nyin bar bteg pa dang / dge bshes gtor phyar bya ba 'bri mtshams pa bgres po gcig gis gtam de thos nas spyan 'dren pa'i grogs la dgos sam 'dir 'ongs pa dang tho rangs 'phrad bas/ bkra shis mtshan mang 'don pa'i 'phro la bab 'dug tshur 'ongs pa'i mgron po nangs kyi snga ba gcig gis/ rta dkar po shin tu bzang ba gcig rnga chas la sogs pas brgyan pa la 'bras bu'i snod zung zhig bkal ba dang phrad/ rta khrid pa'i ngag la brtag snyam pa dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs zhes zer/ co ro'i sa mtshams gnya' chag bya ba dang gang bya ba gnyis su yang rmi ltas 'dod shos re byung / phag ri la btsas su slebs pa dang rgyags kyang zad/ gro mor phyin pa'i tshong pa rnams kyi gtam brgyud pa la bhe dur bya ba ni gro mo'i yul las 'das pa yin yang / gro mo'i sgo nas zhugs pa'i mtha' na tshong dus yod pa tsam la bhe dur zar bya ba dang / bhe dhur nas nyi ma bco brgyad rgya gar rang du 'phags te phyin yang dza ga dha la'i yul snang de ru chad pa yin zer/

de nas bhe dhur sarba ka ri bya ba'i grong khyer sngon chos kyi rgyal po mya ngan med kyi pho brang yin skad de/ rtsa ba brgyad kyi lcags ri sum rim yod pa/ lcags ri gcig gi nang na tshong 'dus chen po bdun yod/ glang po che nyi shu rtsa gcig yod der 'gro ba la yang nyi ma mang po 'gor zer ro/ /der yid chad cing sgyid lug pa 'gyur nas/ phag ri la btsas su yid mi bde bzhin du gnyid log pa'i tshe yang bltas shin tu bzang ba gcig mthong ba dang / de'i gnang dus la dge slong tshul khrims 'od zer bya bas smon 'jug gis sems bskyed zhus nas/ nas sa khyor chen po gang dang / tshos ltang bzhi dang / bur ltang gnyis phul/ de'i nang par don dam sems bskyed zhus nas/ rta gzhon nu bzang po gcig dang / g.yu rdog gcig phul/ de'i nang par bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang bskur zhag cig pa zhus nas gser srang lnga'i maṇḍal dang / khrab bzang po gnyis phul/ der rgyags 'bal 'bol la song gi steng du chos rje gdan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen 'dzom par byung nas cung zad spobs pa skyes so/ /dza ga dha la na bzhugs pa'i re ba med kyang btsang legs su bcad pa'i don du bhe dhur du 'gro bar bsams te chas su byas te/ phag rir ma 'ongs pa'i gong du gro mor 'gro ba la dge bshes rgya pa 'dzems par yod pa thos nas/ rgya mngon shes bya ba rgyang ro drum chung na bzhugs par thos te/ der rje grub thob kyi dus su dbang bskur ba'i slob ma yin pas sna khrid kyi mtshon byed zhu phyin/ sku mtshams shin tu dam por bcad kyang lo tsā ba dngos su 'dug pa gsan nas/ mtshams hag rdol du mdzad de/ drung rgyugs nas phyag 'then mdzad/ don gang la byon dang 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gcig byung bas zhag gsum 'dir bzhugs 'tshal gsung rings kyang gsung bgros de byung ba dang / sngon bla ma zhang rin po che la gdams pa zhur yod pa la/

ma zhus pas 'gyod/ gdan sa pa ba ri rin po che shag ye la zhur yod pa la ma zhus pas kyang 'gyod/ da zhang rin po che'i zhal slob rtsis can rin po che rgya pa 'di yin pas da res mi zhu ba'i thabs med snyam nas/ rgyu mtshan de dag zhus la gal te gnang bar 'dug na bsdad snyam nas zhus pas shin tu yang bgyid/ de ltar na zhag lnga drug bsdad dgos gsungs te zhag dgu bsdad nas zhang rin po che'i man ngag gal che che rnams zhus/ brtsams chos gser la bris pa'i pod chung nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnang ba ma lus par bklags lung gnang / de nas sna khrid pa dge bshes 'dzi ston bya ba dang / dge slong sangs rgyas bya ba gro mo na 'dris che ba gnyis btang / khong gnyis la rje mai tra'i chos chung gnang bar zhu'o zer na zhu rten stag bzang po gnyis phul/ khong gnyis kyi rgyags skal gyi dod gser srang brgyad pa gnyis phul/ rin po che nyid kyis phyi phyag gi rten gser srang gcig bskur ro/ /sna khrid pa gnyis phag rir dus byas pa la bsgugs pas ma thogs pas kyang sngar nur la byung / zhal chems gsum bskur te/ don chen po sgrub pa la ngang ring po srings shig mdung sgro bar mi tshud pas bang chen pa'i lugs cum cum zul zul ma byed par/ 'di tsug byed pa yin no bya ba'i 'ur sha bskyed cig nyi ma nub phyogs nas shar byung yang don 'di 'grub pa yin gyis/ rgya rgan kho khas len zhing 'dug gyis shig gsungs/ yang la btsas kyi rag dung bzang po gcig yod pa de rdzongs su khyer zhig gsungs pas/ sngar yib pe gsang ba'i lugs su bya snyam pa la des gros bsgyur nas 'ud gog 'thag gin 'thag gin phyin no/ /spa dro'i mthil na ding po dgon pa bya ba na rin po che shangs pa gzhon zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed bya ba yin pas/ da res don gang bsgrubs pa 'grub pa yin gsungs nas de'i rtags su don yod grub pa'i gser sku mtho tshad gcig bskur nas don 'grub pa'i brda yin gsung skad/

sku de yang phyis byams chen gyi nang rdzongs la bzhugs so/ /paṇa chung kha che ba dza ya shrī la rta bzang po gcig sbyin par khas blangs nas phar bzlog ste khrid/ wā ra na si ba bya ba'i rgya gar ba gcig la gser srang gnyis khas blangs nas phar khrid/ de gnyis ni bod nas rgya gar du gtong ba'i bang chen pa'i grabs su byas so/ /phag ri gam zhabs phan chad kha ba chen pos non pa la tshul khrims 'od zer gyi rta rgyus mar song bas lam zang nge grangs/ dpon g.yog rnams mig phyid nas tsha ba la dza ti'i chu byugs pas sos/ dge bshes gtor phyar bya ba de bgres pas 'o brgyal bar 'dug nas gro mo'i ri la rdo rje gnam rdzong phrag phug tu dge sbyor dang gsol ba 'debs pa la bzhag yon bdag mang pos zhabs tog byas/ tshur byon tsam na de'i yon bdag tshos sna len byas pa'i tshe 'bum cha dgu dang bur rgyal dang tshos khur sum cu tham pa byung ngo / /sna khrid pa gnyis pos kyang gcom btsun nam mkha' rdo rje bya ba nan tan rgyus che ba gcig khrid/ des dge bskul byas shing phyin nas gro mo rngo khrod bya bar gzhi bcas/ gro mo'i mi chen kun gyis khur bas dgra 'jigs ye med kyi steng du cha rkyen thams cad lhag lhug tu byung / yar lam la nged kyi sar spyan 'dren zer ba mang bas brgyan btang bar byas/ mon nga min bya ba'i lam nas phyin pas/ sa 'khor nas rgya gar gyi mtha' 'khob ka sa ra bya ba'i yul du 'khyams/ de tsho'i rnam thar mthong bas 'jigs kyang 'jigs la ltad mo yang che bar byung / 'di 'dra'i mtha' nas phar yul du ldog dus phal cher mi 'ong snyam pa yang byung / rdzus stag dang pe tom dang / rtsi dug la sogs pa mang po yod pa'i yul mang po rgal lo/ /gcom btsun gyi ngo shes gcig na re/ 'di la phal cher lam 'khyams pa yin pas rgya gar gyi rigs ngan gyi jag pa 'ong sa yin/ /nags kyi mda' gzhu ba bya ba byung na thams cad gsod pa las gcig kyang gtong ba'i lugs med/

mdo 'don pa dang gtor ma gtong ba la nged la mthu byed pa yin zer te brdeg tu 'ong ngo zer/ de la rngan pa cher byin nas lam btsal bas seng ldeng la sogs pa'i nags mthug po mang bo brgal te song ngo / /lam de nas en gcig na sbrul sbram ches dkyus pas seng ldeng gcod pa'i mi gsum tsam shi/ de bzhin du dom 'dogs pas shi ba dang rma byung ba dang / rdzus stag gis bsad pa dang / pe to ma sha za'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas bsad pa dang / gnas pos bla tshe brkus pa la sogs pa'i bar chad mang po 'dug go /grogs po paṇa chung dza ya shrī bya ba la chos rje shākya shrī'i gding ba yin zer ba gcig gnang ba la/ nub mo rtag tu mchod pa dang gsol 'debs byed cing yod pa las/ mtha'i lam ston mkhan de na re/ do nub kyi zhag sa 'di mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad 'ong ba yin/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang / skar ma chen po kun la skyabs 'gro gyis zer/ chos rje'i gding ba de nyal sa'i steng du smyug ma lag ngar tsam pa la rgyangs bzhag pa dang / nub mo me mched pas smyug ma'i tshig tshig pa'i thog sgra rna ba 'gas pa 'dra ba byung / de nas de'i nye 'khor gyi sems can gdug pa can thams cad bros pa yin skad/ nang par tho phyi rnams rjes srad srod mang pos gang / brun shor ba'i rjes mang po 'dug go /de nas res 'ga' ni ri mthon po'i rtse la 'dzegs nas bu yug dang kha ba 'tshubs pa la 'gro dgos par 'dug res 'ga' ni thur la babs nas nags khung gting ring tshad pas 'thibs par song ste lus la rngul chu mang po brubs 'ong bar 'dug ri gzhan pas mtho ba gcig gi rtse mor slebs nas gzhan du 'gro sa med par mun pas chod de gos ma phud par me sbar zhing thun res su byas pa dang / rgya gar shar phyogs bhi me shwa ra bya ba'i yul mthong / me mang po 'bar ba dang / thang ka la nags thib be 'dug de'i gseb na chos rje bzhugs snyam pas dpon g.yog thams cad kyis phyag mang po btsal/

skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs ku co chen po byas/ de'i nub mo kho bos bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i tshigs bcad 'di dag brtsams so/ /bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ bde legs 'byung gnas bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bdun par grags/ /sa chen steng na 'gran gyi zla med pa/ /shākya'i mtshan can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag gi 'gro ba mang la sman slad du/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i gzhung lugs legs gnas phyir/ /gangs can khrod 'dir 'bad pa stong dag gis/ /chos rgyal spyan 'dren bsam sbyor grub par mdzod/ /rang yul gnas na bdag dang gzhan gyi don/ /gal che stong phrag dag kyang yal dor nas/ /srog lus longs spyod ya nga'i sar zhugs kyis/ /skyabs gsum lo ka don grub mkhyen par gsol/ /tshul 'dir bdag la rtsom pa'i bsam yod kyang / /yul dus rkyen gyis sbyor ba'i mthu ma mchis/ /kye ma don med lags te bdag rtsom na/ /sa steng skye bo'i bzhad gad mi 'gyur ram/ /thog mar don 'di ma brtsams ma bsams pa'i/ /gzhan du phal cher 'dus pa'i skye bo la/ /rab grags gyur min lta na de zad mod/ /nga 'dir mang mngar gzhu bcag ji ltar rung / /lo ni gcig bcas bcu yi sngon rol nas/ /rgyun chags gdungs pas rtse gcig gsol bas te/ /brod cing re bas 'di gcig bsgugs bsgugs nas/ /bstan la dga' ba'i lha klu ji ltar sems/ /de bas byang phyogs mi rnams skal pa dang / /bdag gi 'bad shugs nyid kyi thugs rje yis/ /chos don yid la re ba rdzogs bgyis nas/ /dpag med phan bde phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /gang sngon mi bzad dgra bos mngon gzir ba/ /bsad btson 'gro mang nyam thag bde la bkod/ /dge 'di gzhan du ma yin nges par ni/ /srid brtson sgrol phyir don 'di'i rgyur gyur cig /lam zhugs dus tshe'ang mi phyed spro ba dang / /shis brjod dge ba'i ngag gis sngon drangs shing /

/brtson 'grus brtse ba kha na ma tho med/ /bden pa 'dis kyang don 'di 'grub gyur cig /lam gang dkar mdzes rta mchog 'gying bab brtan/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu'i khur khyer thog mar 'phrad/ /bco brgyad grangs tshang skyes bu gzhon par bcas/ /ltas 'di'ang bden pa'i don dam kho nar shog /dar khang gnya' tsha gang gsum rmi ltas dang / /phag ri phag gsum rgya ltas shangs sku ste/ /do gal dus su ltas mtshan gang mthong ba/ /bden na bden pa'i 'bras bu 'dir 'grub shog /lam gang zhugs nas rgya gar yul mtha'i bar/ /la lar mi bzad skyi bser shugs drag gzir/ /la lar bu yug kha ba'i 'dam du bying / /la lar mthong bas skyi g.ya'i g.yang sa bgrod/ /de bzhin gzhan du nyi 'od rab rnos gdungs/ /gzhan du chab rlangs ljan ljin khro lhung sogs/ /sna tshogs 'jigs gnas dka' spyad gang byas 'dis/ /bden na bden 'bras don 'di'i 'bras bur shog /gzhan yang smad pa'i zas gos grogs spyod dang / /rtsi dug rtsi mda' gcan 'phrang bla rkun sogs/ /sna tshogs nad bgegs srog chags chom rkun gyi/ /gnod bzod bden na bden 'bras gnyis 'grub shog /bdag gis bod yul mthil nas rgya gar yul/ /zhag gsum don gnyer lta bur go gyon te/ /sems dpa' gzhan btang chos rje nyid bsams nas/ gsol btab bden na bden 'bras myur 'grub shog /sngon yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug bla ma dang / /paṇa chen ston pa'i mnga' bdag spyan drangs nas/ /grangs med skye bo yang dag rjes bzung 'di/ /bden na bden 'bras deng 'dir smin gyur cig /rgya bod bal gsum ngo mtshar bla ma ni/ /gus brten gsung rgyun bdud rtsi gus 'thungs med/ /'on kyang gcig pu mtshungs med khyod la bdag /ring nas gus dgongs sgom 'bras da gdod gsol/ /sngon byung sras bcas thub pas ma bsgral ba'i/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad myur byon byams pa'i mtshan/ /de sku ri bo mnyam pa 'di rtsom na/

/de sras khyod lags yab don sras mdzad rigs/ /gangs can khrod 'dir bde gshegs bstan pa'i 'od/ /zla skar sgron glog tsam zhig gsal gyur mod/ /sde snod kun srog 'gro ba'i nyi ma khyod/ /shar na chos 'byor longs spyod ches lhag 'gyur/ /rgyal sras rgyal tshab khyod kyi mdzad pa yang / /don 'gyur gdul bya smin grol bsgrub bya las/ /gzhan ci ma mchis re bas mdun sdod pa'i/ /ma lus lus can rjes bzung mdzad par gsol/ /'di na chos med phal pa'i skye bos kyang / /phyogs 'ga' yid gtad de yang mi bslu na/ /thabs stobs thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la bdag /re ba yid chad mdzad na ji ltar mdzes/ /de phyir dal brgyas rgyang ring nas lhags bu/ /rjes 'jug re ba don yod bgyis nas khyod/ /lo ka gsum gyi mgon po'i phrin las ni/ /ma lus cig car lhun grub mdzad par rung / /gnubs ston lo tsā gang phyir gshin rje dang / /gnod sbyin tshal 'dra'i mon yul ri tse na/ /skyo 'jigs yid mi bde bas smre bzhin du/ /bden rtogs 'di brjod bltas don mthun par shog /ces brjod de/ de nas bang chen pa rnams rgya gar shar phyogs su btang la/ 'o skol dpon slob kha cig mtha' 'khob kyi sa char gsol ba 'debs shing bsdad ces gros byas so/ /de yang rgya gar gyi thang la gnas pa'i yul rnams su gar log byung na mi legs pas/ mon gyi ri'i khongs su gtogs la rgya gar la kha bltas pa'i btsan sa brangs bya bar bsdad la/ /re shig bhe dhur tshong dus kyi rnam bzhag blta yin rgyags btsal lo/ /zhes bgros nas bhe dhur du zhag 'ga' bsdad nas gdan 'dren la gtong ba'i pho nya rnams gtong dgos pa de dus tshod 'phyis pa dang / lam 'jigs pa che bas dka' bar byung / paṇa chung dza ya shrī dang / wā ra ṇa si ba gnyis rgya gar gyi lo tsā ba byed pa dang / rngan pa byin par song bas nam yang chas/ bod mi gnyis dgos pas spro ba dris pa dang /

jo sras nyi ma na re/ nga 'gro bas tshur mi bzlog pa'i rtsis bya dgos zer te/ kha chems bzhag khams pa byang chub grags na re/ shi yang don che bas nga yang kha chems bzhag la 'gro'o zer ro/ /lha khang gcig tu gsol ba btab la btang snyam nas bhe dhur gyi yul khams na rgya bod chu mig la sogs pa mi grong thug med yod kyang nang pa'i mchod khang ye ma rnyed/ rgyal phran gyi dod gnas po sa ral na bya ba dang ma hā ral na bya ba'i 'du khang na byis pa rnams kyi rtsed mo'i rten la mahā bo dhi …byang chub chen po 'jim pa la byas pa gcig dang / mchod rten gcig 'dug pa brang khang du spyan drangs te/ phyag mchod byas nas bar chod med par gsol ba btab/ chos rje la gser la dris pa'i sher snying bod yig cig sngon 'gror btang nas gser srang lnga'i maṇḍal dang / mi nyag gha nas 'ongs pa'i na bza' dar chen bzang po phrugs gcig dang / 'ju zab shin tu bzang ba'i bla bre gcig yig rten la bskur nas/ bod du byon par zhu ba'i gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag rgya yig gis saṃskri ta'i skad du bris te bskur ro/ /bod skad du bsgyur na 'di skad ces byas te/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya'i bstan la shākya'i sras bltams shākya'i mtshan/ /lnga rig gtsug nor dri med brtul zhugs brtan po 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ngo mtshar chos bzhis khyad 'phags gang / /pan chen dam pas bdag sogs rjes 'dzin skyong gyur cig /re zhig dus nas khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /rab dang dga' skyes spu ldang mchi ma 'khrug 'gyur ba/ /rigs ldan bu zhig gangs can khrod nas nyin mtshan du/ /thal sbyar spyi btud gdung pas gsol 'debs mkhyen par mdzod/ /ma ga dha sogs rig 'byung gnas ni sdig to yis/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcom u rg+yyan kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/

/bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs skyong zhu/ /sems dpa' gzhan btang khyod la yid byed gcig po yis/ /cir yang ma chags dka' ba du ma khyad bsad cing / /'dod pa'i yul spangs shul rings bgrod dka'i lam zhugs te/ /ngal rgyas mchis so re ba ma lus mchis par mdzod/ /rgyal sras khyod la don 'gyur gdul bya rjes 'dzin las/ /gzhan lta mchis drang nus yod bzhin yang byams pa'i phas/ /bsad sar bu khrid ci dgar yal dor 'drar gyur na/ /kye ma khyed thabs thugs rje gang lags bdag lags gsungs/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /pho nya ba bzhi pos yig rten dang bcas pa khyer nas zhag drug cu rtsa bzhi la dru ba zhes bya ba'i tshong dus su slebs pa dang / chos rje nyid 'khor paṇḍi ta'i tshogs dang bcas pa tshong 'dus der zhag 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa las ci yang med par gyur phrin nas/ slar dza gha dha la bi ha rar bzlog par dgongs te khur chas byed pa dang 'dzoms par gyur te/ pho nya bas yi ge 'phrin rten dang bcas pa phul bas/ paṇa chung dgu yod pa la bka' bstsal ba/ sngar nga dza ga dha la nas 'dir 'ongs pa'i tshe yang byang phyogs nas gdan 'dren do gal can yod pas 'gro dgos ces ma smras sam/ 'dir 'ongs pas ci yang mi 'dug ste/ phar bzlog par chas pa na yang / da rung sdod cig pho nya bas sleb la khad do zhes ma smras sam/ da 'di ltar gyur pa la gros ji lta bu rigs zhes gsungs so/ /paṇa chung la sogs pa thams cad ya mtshan du gyur te/ 'di lta bu bsod nams kyi bskal ba can re re tsam gyi spyod yul ma lags par gzhan dag gis sgrub tu rung ba'i rigs su mi gda' bas/ gnas skabs 'di 'dra bdag cag gis ga la shes/ chos rje nyid mkhyen par zad do zhes zer skad/ de nas chos rjes rje btsun sgrol ma'i rten la maṇḍal dang bcas pa bshams nas/ kho bo'i gros thams cad bha ḍi la zhu ba yin pas/ rmi ltas brtag go zhes gsungs nas/

zhag lnga sku mtshams dam por mdzad do/ /yul der bod la rigs ngan du byed pas/ khang pa mi rnyed/ ka ca la reg tu mi 'jug zas kyi g.yos cha gang yang mi ster bas nyam thag par yod pa la/ sngon paṇa chen buddha shriā'i slob ma mañdzu rā dza bya ba'i ma rgan btsun ma byas pa gcig grong de'i nye na 'dug pas dgos cha rnams bsgrubs/ zas kyi g.yos byas shing bskyal skad/ gnas mal yang mgron khang bstan te ci bder bzhag go /phyis de'i drin dran pas zab chen yug cig dang / dngul bre tshad ma gcig lhag par byin no/ /zhag lnga nas chos rje'i mtshams bkrol nas ltas bzang po byung bas 'gro dgos te/ lam 'jigs pa che bas rgyal po sarba ka ra'i rgyal phran gcig lam ka na yod pa la bsu ba la shog ces sbran dgos/ bod kyi mi rnams la yang brnyas pa ma byed par bsnyen bkur gyis shig ces gsungs so/ /de ma thag tu dza ga dha la'i gnas brtan chen po mang pos dge 'dun stong phrag gsum bod du mi gshegs par shol 'debs la khrid byung / rgya gar na don gal che ba la brten gdan 'dren pa'i lugs yin pas/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po gcig ngo chen du khrid la spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur chen po mdzad nas zhu phul/ gnas brtan rā hu la bha dra …sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po bya ba chos rje'i slob ma gcig na re/ paṇḍi ta ba kasmi ra …mkhas bdag dran 'di jo mo sgrol ma la yi dam du mdzad pa yin/ khar sang dza ga dha la nas la dru bar gshegs pa yang bha ḍis mtshan ltas bstan pa yin gsungs nas bzhud/ thugs rje chen po'i drung du sgrol ma'i rten gcig kyang dgos zer nas/ tsand+ra gau mi'i tā ra bya ba gcig bzhugs so/ /kha che'i paṇa chung gis lha rnams kyi gnyer byed pa gcig la gsug byin te/ thugs rje chen po 'dren pa'i shing rta de gzer chag par byas/ sgrol ma'i zhal phyir bsgyur te bzhag go

/de la chos rjes kyang ldang ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba la bzhud dgos pa lugs yin pas/ la dru bar 'bul ba byung ba'i 'gron bu kar sha pa na dpag tu med pa dge 'dun la phul nas bzlogs kyang / lha dang dge 'dun gyis ngo chen mdzad pa la phyir mi bzlog pa'i thabs med pas re shig bzlog dgos par gyur to/ /de ltar shing pho byi ba'i lo rta zla'i tshes bdun la dza ga dha la nas tshong 'dus la dru bar byon te/ srod thun gyi dge sbyor thon la khad pa na dza ga dha la'i gandho la'i steng nas lha gsum babs te/ gcig mi yul gyi chos pa rnams la phan 'dogs pa lha'i bu gtsug tor can bya ba yin zer te/ gtsug nas nor bu rin po che bkrol nas 'bul zer ba la/ chos rjes nga bsod snyoms pa yin pas nor bu rin po che mi 'dod gsungs/ gcig rgyal chen rigs bzhi la phan 'dogs pa lha'i bu gser mdog can bya ba yin zer nas gser la byas pa'i me tog gsum 'bul du byung bas/ dkon mchog gsum la re re phul/ gcig rnam thos kyi bu bya ba lha mi'i yul thams cad du chos su byed kyang kun la phan 'dogs pa yin zer nas lhung bzed 'bras chen gyis gang pa gcig phul lo/ /byang phyogs kha ba can bya ba yi dwags chos 'dzin bya ba'i yul gcig yod de/ der rgyal ba byams pa'i sku tshad bzhengs pa'i grogs ldan la byon par zhu zer skad/ byams pa'i sku ci 'dra ba gcig yod bris pas 'jim pa'i lder so gcig bstan nas 'di 'dra gcig yin te zhabs mgo gnyis dang phyag mgo gnyis las ma tshar zer skad/ sku de las 'od zer mang po byung nas yul khams mi 'dra ba mang por song zhing 'di la brten nas las 'brel bzhag tshad myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur/ rje btsun byams pa'i bstan pa la 'khor ba las thar ba yin skad/ 'o na nga yang rje btsun byams pa la gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas 'gro dgos snyam pa dang nyams snang de sad par gyur to/

/phyis dus tshod brtsis pas lo tsā bas nyin mo de ka'i snga nyin yul nas bteg ste/ spyan 'dren du chas par 'dug go /de nas zhag kha cig la dru bar bsgugs kyang gdan 'dren pa po su yang med pas skyo bar gyur te/ dza gha dha la nyid du phyir ldog par byas pa la/ chos rje'i mtshan bltas su da rung bzhugs shig /da ste zhag gsum na bod kyi gdan 'dren pa 'ong ngo zhes bya ba byung / de kho na ltar zhag gsum gyi nang par pho nya ba bzhi pos slebs so/ /de nas rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol 'debs zhag lnga mdzad de/ ltas bzang ngan brtags pas shin tu bzang bar bstan/ de'i rjes la dza ga dha la ba rnams kyis shol btab pas nur byung ba'i dus nyid du/ lo tstsha ba mon yul brang sar gzhi bzung nas/ nyi ma re re chos spyod brgya rtsa tshar re byas nas gsol ba 'debs shing yod pa las/ nub gcig rmi lam na 'phags pa bhu kam ya rtse'i shing rta kho na 'dra ba gcig bcas zin nas/ rje btsun byams pa'i sku gzugs shing las byas pa gcig bzhag nas shing rta'i rnga thag brtags zin nas 'dren 'dod pa na/ zlos gar mkhan gyi seng ge'i mgo can dang phag rgod kyi mgo can gnyis kyis shing rta de kha phyir la bsgyur nas drangs so/ /'o cag de kho na nan tar mi 'dod pas ji tsam zlog kyang ma phan no snyam nas/ /du kha drag po skyes te ngus pas gnyid sad de bsams pa na/ chos rje lam du chud chud nas phyir log par 'dug snyam ste/ yang thabs gzhan med pas chos spyod brgya rtsa cha gsum du byas nas/ lha gnad la bor ba'i gsol 'debs byas so/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa bkod pa ni/ kyi hud kyi hud nyam thag kun skyabs thabs stobs kun sgrub lha/ /rnam sras khyod gson paṇa chen gdan drang phyir/ /rang nus sbyar bgyis dka' spyad stong 'bad kyang / /ngal ba don med bdag la de ring gzigs/ /gdul bya'i re skong yid bzhin nor 'dra khyod/

/bdag mgon mdzad bzhin shing rta lam zhugs nas/ /phyir log lam chen las nyams ya ngar khrid/ /kyi hud khyed thabs thugs rje lags sam ci/ /bdag dang byang phyogs 'gro la 'di 'grub ba'i/ /rgyu rkyen gzhi nyid med na sngon nyid du/ /rmi ltas tsam gyis ci ste bzlog mi mdzad/ /do gal dus su yal dor bdag rab brlag /da ni rin chen gling song lag stong dang / /nus ldan phas mthong bsad btson khrid 'drar 'gyur/ /skabs 'di mngon sum spyan gyi gzigs bzhin yang / /ci dgar mdor na kyi hud thabs ci mchis/ thabs ci mchis/ thabs ci mchis/ zhes bar du rmi ltas log nas lha gnad la bor ro// //de'i tshe chos rje 'khor bcas kyis dza ga dha lar phar log pa'i lam la zhag kha cig gis byon nas zhag bdun phyag dang skor ba mchod pa mang du mdzad kyang thugs phebs par yang ma gyur/ mtshan lam gyi za zi la yang dang yang du sngar gyi lha gsum po des bskul ba'i bltas nyi tshe byung ngo / /yang rje btsun sgrol ma la zhus pas/ da rung 'dir ma 'dug par song zhig shing rta'i ngo chen la drangs pa'i rten gnyis ka phyin ci log tu bsgyur yod de/ jo bo thugs rje chen po'i 'khor lo ni gzer chag pas zhabs gog por song / nga'i gzugs ni khros nas kha phyir la log dge 'dun ni nor 'dod pa las chos 'dod pa ni nyung bas/ 'gron bu rnams kyis tshim par gyur/ 'dir ci byed ci byed byang phyogs su song zhig song zhig gsung skad/ de nas gnas brtan dang dge 'dun rnams la zhus te/ yang phyir bod du byon pa'i chas byas so/ /de'i rjes la paṇa chung dang wā ra ṇa si ba gnyis tshad pas mi 'jigs pas sngon la dga' ston gyi dril bsgrag par bya ba/ /gtam snyan skyel ba tshogs che bar bshad pas/ chos rjes thugs la btags pa'i yig phrin 'di khyer nas myur ba myur bar 'ongs so/ /lha gnad la bor ba'i 'og tu zhag gsum lon pa na/ lo tsā bas zhag bcu gsum na byon par 'dug pa'i chad shes par byung ste/

yang rmi lam du rang gi slob ma jo mo rnal 'byor skyid bya ba gcig gi ming po la/ gro kha la bris pa'i yi ge bskur nas/ dge slong bai shra ba na ye bya bas springs pa/ da ste zhag bcu gsum na byams pa shākya shrī byon par yod de/ der ma 'dug par sngon du ldang ba byed pa la grong khyer ka ru ṇa bya bar shog bya ba 'dug yi ge ma bklags tsam na rgya yig tu 'dug pa la bklags pas bod yig tu song ngo / /kho bo dga' ches pas gnyis sad de khang thog gcig tu phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs byas pas chu nad kyis rkang pa gnyis ka chu 'brum gan bru bya ba dug can gcig byung yod pa la de'i nang par chu ser 'jib pa'i srog chags btsal bzhog snyam pa las rgyugs pas gan bru zhar nas chu ser rdol lo/ /grogs po rnams la bkyal kha smras pa/ /thum thum gnyid kyi rmi lam bzang / /dga' ba'i sems la bzod thabs med/ /rkang pa gar bzhag cha yang med/ /na na tsha tsha'i chu 'brum zhar/ /gnyid longs gnyid longs la 'ur shog /gtam snyan gyis ni lung pa bkang / /skal ldan gyis ni rgyal khams bkang / /dam chos kyis ni 'dzam gling bkang / /zhes smras so/ /dge bshes 'dzi ston na re/ 'o 'di ka 'dra gcig nga la yang na ning du byung / don ma grub pa gcig la du kha che nas yong thog la don de grub nas khu teg ge phyin pa gcig yod/ de ka 'dir 'dug go /bso tho le/ bso tho le gyis shig zer thams cad kyis ku co bskyed nas bso tho le mang po mang po byas so/ /rmi lam gyi dus thog dri bzhin du rnal 'byor skyid kyi ming po gcig gis/ rgya gar gyi bang chen pa gnyis rkang pa na bas i khu be na shong bya ba'i grong khyer chen por bzhag nas sngon la 'ongs te/ mon yul brang sar slebs so/ /rnal 'byor pa de la chos rje nyid kyi phyag bris kyi phrin lan dang / byang chub shing la 'dab ma gsum/ sha kha ra phul gang bskur 'dug
